$comment: Seed list imported via 'JSON'dan içe aktar' (POST /api/v1/streamers/import). Only add channels whose owners granted recording/re-upload permission. Fields: name, platform (twitch|youtube|kick|other), channel_url (https), is_active, recording_permission_confirmed, permission_notes (required when permission is confirmed). Existing channels are skipped.
